Compute p-values

Source: R/compute_pvalue.R
compute_pvalue.Rd

Converts the Welch statistics in input_obj$teststat_vec to Gaussian statistics via their Welch-Satterthwaite degrees of freedom, fits an empirical null with multtest, and returns two-sided p-values on the \(-\log_{10}\) scale with Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment.

Usage

compute_pvalue(input_obj, min_cells_per_individual = 3, verbose = 0, ...)

Arguments

input_obj

eSVD object output from compute_test_statistic.

min_cells_per_individual

Minimum number of cells an individual must contribute; see compute_test_statistic.

verbose

Integer.

...

Additional parameters.

Value

eSVD object with added element "pvalue_list", a list with df_vec, fdr_vec, gaussian_teststat, log10pvalue (\(-\log_{10}\) of the two-sided p-value), method (which empirical-null estimator ran; see multtest), null_mean and null_sd.

Examples

set.seed(10)
sim <- generate_null(cell_per_person = 15, num_genes = 40,
                     num_individuals = 8)
esvd_obj <- initialize_esvd(dat = sim$obs_mat,
                            covariates = sim$covariates,
                            metadata_individual = sim$metadata_individual,
                            case_control_variable = "CC",
                            bool_intercept = TRUE,
                            k = 2,
                            lambda = 0.1)
esvd_obj <- reparameterization_esvd_covariates(input_obj = esvd_obj,
                                               fit_name = "fit_Init",
                                               omitted_variables = "Log_UMI")
esvd_obj <- opt_esvd(input_obj = esvd_obj,
                     max_iter = 5,
                     offset_variables = setdiff(colnames(esvd_obj$covariates), "CC"),
                     fit_name = "fit_First",
                     fit_previous = "fit_Init")
esvd_obj <- reparameterization_esvd_covariates(input_obj = esvd_obj,
                                               fit_name = "fit_First",
                                               omitted_variables = "Log_UMI")
esvd_obj <- estimate_nuisance(input_obj = esvd_obj)
esvd_obj <- compute_posterior(input_obj = esvd_obj,
                              alpha_max = 2 * max(sim$obs_mat))
esvd_obj <- compute_test_statistic(input_obj = esvd_obj)
esvd_obj <- compute_pvalue(input_obj = esvd_obj)
esvd_obj$pvalue_list$method
#> [1] "locfdr"
utils::head(esvd_obj$pvalue_list$fdr_vec)
#>    gene_1    gene_2    gene_3    gene_4    gene_5    gene_6 
#> 0.4332071 0.4531028 0.9764068 0.4332071 0.8221153 0.4332071
